mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_seat_reservation ( gmt_create, gmt_modify, seat_row, seat_number, seat_code, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name, consultant_code, consultant_sequence, poster_url, ticket_image_path, email_image_path ) VALUES ( NOW(), NOW(), #{seatRow}, #{seatNumber}, #{seatCode}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{ip}, #{consultantName}, #{consultantCode}, #{consultantSequence}, #{posterUrl}, #{ticketImagePath}, #{emailImagePath} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE seat_code = #{seatCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE name = #{name} AND email = #{email} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT consultant_sequence FROM b_seat_reservation WHERE consultant_name = #{consultantName} ORDER BY consultant_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT seat_code FROM b_seat_reservation ORDER BY seat_row, seat_number

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_number AS seatNumber, seat_code AS seatCode, name, email, phone, ip, consultant_name AS consultantName, consultant_code AS consultantCode, consultant_sequence AS consultantSequence, poster_url AS posterUrl, ticket_image_path AS ticketImagePath, email_image_path AS emailImagePath FROM b_seat_reservation ORDER BY id
